liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (6 reviews): The transition from Scarlet into Fire is very spacey, with the percussion locked in; The Scarlet into Fire has a laid-back, west coast psychedelic feel [8][9][13][14][16][18]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (3 reviews): Bobby forgets more lyrics than usual, which draws laughs; Bobby stumbles in Bucket, the only loose spot in an otherwise tight first set [11][16][17]
- **Ramble On Rose** (2 reviews): The first-set Ramble On Rose is especially hot; Reviewer calls the Ramble nearly the most perfect tune they ever saw live [11][16]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 other source): A tape flip at 6:34 in Terrapin leaves about two minutes missing [5]
- **Turn On Your Love Light** (1 review): Phil and the drummers start Lovelight while Jerry keeps jamming on Stella Blue, building higher [13]
- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue** (1 review): The encore Baby Blue was sweet and capped off the night [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-02-26.137963.dbx.hale.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 34 songs; 311 min [1]
- **gd90-02-26.sbd.shakedown.451.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 153 min; rated 4.4/5 by 30 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds great [15]
- **gd1990-02-26.fob.senn421.alabamabob.andrewf.93841.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 17 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1990-02-26.137905.mtx.photoleon.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 168 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- First-set stage banter included Bobby asking whether the crowd was ready for star time [8]
- Crowd chants for Phil and Bobby's star time banter come before Tom Thumb's Blues [11]
- Reviewer rates this show better than the previous night's, February 25th [10]
- The show foreshadows the strong music of Spring Tour 1990 [14]
- Reviewer ranks this Scarlet into Fire among the top five or ten ever [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-02-26.137963.dbx.hale.flac16**: taped by Gris; transferred by Hale; source: Source: (2)Nak CP-100s w/CP-4 shotgun capsules > Tascam PortaOne 4-track cassette w/dbx type II on > Maxell XLII-S; Maxell XLII-S > Onkyo TA-2027 > dbx-224X… [1]. Also: Taped by Gris, a touring and taping partner of the uploader, using the uploader's gear [1]
- **gd90-02-26.sbd.shakedown.451.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHN [2]
- **gd1990-02-26.fob.senn421.alabamabob.andrewf.93841.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alabama Bob; transferred by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD: Sennheiser MD-421's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA 90's with no Dolby. Mics on six-foot stand, at 90-degree spread, thirty feet from the stage, in the center. [5]. Also: Drums were not recorded on the MAC source, and a tape flip in Space was mended [5]
- **gd1990-02-26.137905.mtx.photoleon.t-flac16**: transferred by Matrix by photoleon; source: flac16/48kHz ; 2 source matrix by PhotoLeon using Audacity 2.0.6; Source 1: [shnid: 451] SBD > DAT; Conversion: D100 > Montego II > CD > HD via EAC > SHN; and… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-02-26 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1990-02-26-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [21]
